provenance: Development-only policy sentinels derived from canonical P024, P001, and P050 traces. No holdout data and no new model calls.

cases.risk: a qualified first-party page can place exact-NPI evidence, exact provider name, and supported contact facts in separate readable regions
cases.policy: qualify identity from the whole page, then cite separate contiguous item-local identity and fact spans without demanding NPI in every span

cases.risk: a shortened common name can attach another professional's contact facts to the requested provider
cases.policy: treat the shortened name as insufficient by itself, but permit page-level reconciliation through multiple compatible provider-specific biographical identifiers with no conflicting-provider evidence

cases.risk: a supported first-party website URL can be paired with a fabricated descriptive fact span
cases.policy: use sourceUrl as the URL evidence and copy the shortest exact provider or organization heading or name passage, reusing the identity span when appropriate
